name: Hyper-Field Projector
description:
The State will reward anyone who participates in their campaign objective and delivers this to their item trader outside the Caldari Navy Anchorage in <url=showinfo:5//30045324>Onnamon</url>.

This Drifter energy field projector has been modified in an attempt to connect it to a conventional power source, similar to the type that might be found in any civilian structure.
